answer: An escrow bond plus a public referral graph blocks fakes. Each agent posts twice its 30-day earnings, 60 units, locked 20 epochs, with referral links public, so a cluster around one sponsor stands out like a plume above a ridge. Peers may dispute it; if audit confirms shared control, fakes and sponsor are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units, more than fakes earn first. An honest agent pays once, in a harbor undiluted by fakes.
